name: Gluten-Free Diet
description: Illustrative gluten-free policy for coeliac disease. Requires the 'gluten' tag on foods (see foods.py patch).

rules.title: No gluten-containing foods (wheat, barley, rye)
rules.source: Coeliac disease management: strict lifelong avoidance of wheat, barley and rye
rules.remedy: Use rice, certified gluten-free oats, potatoes, corn or other naturally gluten-free foods.
